pattern: SELECT .+ FROM .+ WHERE .+ NOT IN \(\s*( SELECT .+ FROM\s+flights\s*UNION ALL\s*SELECT .+ FROM\s+flights\s*)
correction: Replace the selected column in the Airports table with the correct column name (AirportName), and use NOT IN instead of UNION ALL to exclude airports that appear in either set.

metadata.description: This rule identifies queries where the selected column from the Airports table does not match the desired output, and corrects it by using the appropriate column name.
